required_documents.name: Application Submission in JustGrants
required_documents.details: Two-step submission completed through Grants.gov and JustGrants portal.

required_documents.name: Forensic Appendix
required_documents.details: Forensic documentation and protocol appendix required for human remains identification.

eligibility.summary: Other units of local government (towns, boroughs, parishes, villages, or other general purpose political subdivisions of a state); Accredited, publicly funded, CODIS forensic laboratories; Medical examiner offices; Accredited, publicly funded toxicology laboratories; Accredited, publicly funded crime laboratories In North Carolina, eligible entities fitting the organizational requirements may apply.

cost_share.details: No cost sharing or non-federal matching funds are required.

review_criteria.criterion: Work Plan Feasibility and Milestone Schedule

submission_limits: Applicant organizations may submit more than one proposal, provided each proposal is scientifically distinct.
important_notes: Application submission is administered via Grants.gov or the designated federal portal for opportunity O-BJA-2026-172716.
SAM.gov registration must be active with valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) prior to submission; allow 3-4 weeks for new registrations.
Review all instructions, eligibility requirements, and deadlines published on Grants.gov before preparing submission.
